import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import re
import os
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.calibration import CalibratedClassifierCV
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from xgboost import XGBClassifier
import time

start_time = time.time()

# Load data from input directory
train_df = pd.read_csv("input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("input/test.csv")
sample_sub_path = "input/sample_submission_null.csv"

# Load sample submission template if available
if os.path.exists(sample_sub_path):
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv(sample_sub_path)
else:
    sample_sub = pd.DataFrame(columns=["Id", "Probability"])

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")
print(f"Labels distribution:\n{train_df['Insult'].value_counts(normalize=True)}")


# Enhanced text preprocessing with case normalization and comprehensive cleanup
def preprocess_text(text):
    # Convert to lowercase for consistent feature alignment
    text = str(text).lower()
    # Remove HTML entities
    text = re.sub(r"&#\d+| |<|>|"", "", text)
    # Remove special characters but keep word boundaries
    text = re.sub(r"[^\w\s]", " ", text)
    # Clean excessive whitespace
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()
    return text


# Apply preprocessing to all datasets
train_df["preprocessed_text"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["preprocessed_text"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Stratified Train-Val Split - holdout validation without refitting on full data
X_train_full, X_val, y_train_full, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_df["preprocessed_text"],
    train_df["Insult"],
    test_size=0.2,
    random_state=42,
    stratify=train_df["Insult"],
)

# TF-IDF Vectorizer for word features
tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=15000, ngram_range=(1, 3), min_df=2, max_df=0.8, sublinear_tf=True
)

# Fit vectorizer on training set
X_train_word = tfidf.fit_transform(X_train_full)

# Transform validation and test data
X_val_word = tfidf.transform(X_val)
X_test_word = tfidf.transform(test_df["preprocessed_text"])

# Combine word features only (removing expensive character features)
X_train_combined = X_train_word
X_val_combined = X_val_word
X_test_combined = X_test_word

# Calculate class balance for imbalanced handling
positives = len([l for l in y_train_full if l == 1])
negatives = len(y_train_full) - positives
scale_pos_weight = negatives / positives if positives > 0 else 1
print(f"Class balance ratio: {scale_pos_weight:.2f}")

# Initialize optimized XGBoost with early stopping
xgb = XGBClassifier(
    n_estimators=500,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    max_depth=6,
    gamma=0.0,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    reg_alpha=0.01,
    reg_lambda=0.01,
    scale_pos_weight=scale_pos_weight,
    verbosity=0,
    random_state=42,
    eval_metric="auc",
)

# Fit with early stopping on validation set
best_val_score = 0.0
max_rounds = 500
early_stop_rounds = 0

for i, train_subset in enumerate(
    train_train_splits := [X_train_full[:], X_train_full[:]]
):
    pass  # Single iteration for now

# Alternative single fit approach
xgb.fit(
    X_train_combined.toarray(),
    y_train_full,
    eval_set=[(X_val_combined.toarray(), y_val)],
    early_stopping_rounds=100,
    verbose=False,
    max_iter=max_rounds,
)

# Validation predictions
y_xgb_proba = xgb.predict_proba(X_val_combined)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_xgb_proba)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Test Set Predictions
y_test_proba = xgb.predict_proba(X_test_combined)[:, 1]

# Create submission file matching sample submission format
submission = sample_sub.copy()
submission["Probability"] = y_test_proba.round(6)

# Save to required location
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

# Verify submission exists
if os.path.exists("./submission/submission.csv"):
    print(f"Successfully created submission with {submission.shape[0]} rows")
else:
    print("ERROR: Submission file not created successfully!")

# Print final evaluation metric
print(val_auc)
